title: Reversal of Fees and Interest on Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
**Customer care desk guidance — Home Comfort Financing reversals.**

## Courtesy reversal of a late fee

A late fee may be reversed as a courtesy, by a late-fee reversal naming that fee, only while fewer than the plan's courtesy reversal allowance of late fees have been reversed on the account in the 12 months before the reversal date, and only when the account is active and the late payment has since been made. Put another way: a late fee may be reversed as a courtesy only while the count of late-fee reversals in the preceding 12 months is below the plan's allowance. The count is of late-fee reversal entries on the account in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of handling.

All three conditions must hold together:

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| Late-fee reversals on the account in the preceding 12 months below the plan's allowance | the account's reversal entries |
| Account status is active | the account record |
| The late payment has since been made | the account's payment entries |

## Reversal of a fee charged in error

A late fee or returned-payment fee charged in error, such as one posted although the payment arrived within the grace period, is reversed in full regardless of the courtesy count.

## Reversal of interest

Interest is reversed, by an interest reversal naming the charge, only when it was charged in error. The errors are:

- an autopay APR reduction not applied while autopay was enrolled;
- interest posted during an equal-payment promotion;
- deferred interest assessed although the promotional balance was paid in full by the end of the promotional end date.

Deferred interest correctly assessed is never reversed as a courtesy.

## One reversal per charge

Each reversal names the charge it reverses; a charge that already carries a late-fee reversal or an interest reversal is not reversed again.

## Illustrations (hypothetical accounts, an allowance of 1)

| Account | Late-fee reversals in the preceding 12 months | Status | Late payment since made | Courtesy reversal of the new late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 0 | active | yes | may be granted |
| B | 1 | active | yes | not available: the count is not below 1 |
| C | 0 | delinquent | yes | not available: the account is not active |
| D | 0 | active | no | not available: the late payment has not been made |

An account whose late fee was posted although the payment arrived within the grace period has that fee reversed in full whatever its courtesy count.
